description: Warning!! If you make these salted caramel cookies, your family will harass you to make them for the rest of your life - AND YES I’m speaking from experience #cookie #cookierecipe #cookietiktok #cookietime #baking #recipe
transcript: Warning, if you make these salted caramel cookies, your family will harass you for the rest of your life to make them as many times as possible. The proof is in the pudding right here. The craziest thing is this was probably only within the last month that I screen shot of these text messages because my family is literally so obsessed with them and they cannot get enough. So this time I decided to help them a little bit and I doubled the batch so they would have more on hand throughout the week. So I don't have to make it as much. Fortunately for me, the recipe is so easy to make. So I really don't mind making it and also did you see the first few clips? The cookies aren't gorgeous, so I'm obsessed. I just bake off of really traditional cookie and then I make a beautiful creamy cream cheese frosting. It is so simple to make. I just add cream cheese, butter, vanilla bean extract and then I add in powdered sugar and once it is the perfect creamy consistency, I put them on each cookie. I add my homemade salted caramel and then I smear that all around to make sure you get caramel every single bite. I top with flaky sea salt and enjoy.
